findings.description: Baseline grid alignment relies on visual inspection only. Add ruler overlay or programmatic measurement to strengthen the PASS claim for requirement (e).
Opening window implementation code present in adapters but non-functional. Consider removing broken code or marking clearly as 'attempted, non-functional'.
TOC page number generation not attempted in either adapter. RESULTS.md correctly identifies this as FAIL with workaround estimates, but this is a critical production feature.
Determinism test conflates PDF metadata timestamps with layout determinism. Strip metadata and retest to isolate actual layout behavior, or clarify that layout determinism is not being tested.
